reviewer_independence: Reviewer participated in Native/link production and a narrow audit.py component; independent reconciliation method, not wholly independent product/harness implementation author.
scope: Six completed health groups/18actual directional fault phases only. Other preparation/rawv1 groups belong to other reviewers. No partial run accepted as terminal.
limits: TLS1.3 ServerHello and exact client ALPN offer are clear handshake observations; no encrypted server ALPN, internal h2 PING/PONG or USB completion inferred from ciphertext.

Sequential root/sysfs/FD snapshots are not atomic. Exact helper capability proofs are separate from transport timeout and app cleanup.
No managed Native/USBFS pending URB proof or kernel-internal hard block; no hardware or ARM QEMU runtime claim. Virtual has actual CDC echo, no invented QMP HID input or server physical proof.
Each source capture, actual ELF, original phase tuple/session and artifact is attributed to this1582 run. Older531/222FAIL evidence remains separate.
Host ACK/START timestamps are send completion observations, not guest receipt or exact nc syscall timestamps.
No Cargo, QEMU, program/helper execution, host USB/module/network mutation or repository edits.

parent_progress_observation.scope: Append-only parent is still allowed to run remaining compatibility jobs; only the six completed child originals are immutable review inputs.

counter_semantics: Diagnostic predicates include per-byte TCP retransmission equality. They are not test executions/USB cases/independent reviewers.
